title: Supporting Check: Does the P2P gossip validation layer validate commitment_indices bounds before passing to verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: validateDataColumn calls VerifyDataColumnSidecar which validates sidecar.Index < numberOfColumns before calling VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs. No separate commitment_indices array exists; the sidecar.Index (column index 0..127) is used directly as cell_index in the (commitment, index, cell, proof) tuple passed to ckzg4844.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch. Bounds enforcement happens at VerifyDataColumnSidecar stage.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No counterexample found. sidecar.Index is uint64 validated < numberOfColumns (128) before use. ckzg4844 C library enforces CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB (128) internally.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: P2P gossip path: decodePubsubMessage (SSZ) -> validateDataColumn -> VerifyDataColumnSidecar (bounds check) -> VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs -> ckzg4844. Attacker-controlled input is validated before any array access.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Invariant: sidecar.Index < numberOfColumns is verified in VerifyDataColumnSidecar before KZG proof call. ckzg4844 library provides additional bounds checking internally.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Bounds validation is properly enforced. VerifyDataColumnSidecar rejects sidecar.Index >= numberOfColumns before any cryptographic operation.

title: Supporting Check: Can a malicious P2P peer cause validator node crash by sending crafted commitment_indices exceeding array bounds?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: SSZ deserialization enforces field sizes before validation logic runs. VerifyDataColumnSidecar then validates index bounds. No out-of-bounds array access can occur on attacker input.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No counterexample found. Attacker cannot craft a sidecar that bypasses SSZ size constraints and index bounds check.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Crash path requires: (1) SSZ to accept malformed message, (2) VerifyDataColumnSidecar to pass out-of-bounds index. Both conditions are independently prevented.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: No crash path exists. Go runtime provides bounds checking on all slice accesses.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: SSZ deserialization + VerifyDataColumnSidecar + Go runtime bounds checking

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Multiple independent guards prevent out-of-bounds crash. Not a vulnerability.

title: Supporting Check: What is the memory safety impact of out-of-bounds commitment_indices access in verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl?

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No memory safety issue reachable from P2P attacker-controlled input.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: ckzg4844 is a well-audited C reference implementation. Index validated before C FFI call.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Memory safety invariant holds. Pre-validation in Go prevents invalid indices from reaching C library.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: No memory safety vulnerability. Index bounds are enforced before C library FFI.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Length mismatch impossible: validated before assembly, and assembly iterates same-length slices.

title: Supporting Check: Can a malicious P2P peer crash a validator node by sending batch KZG verification request with mismatched array lengths?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Mismatched-length attack path: attacker would need to send a sidecar where len(Column) != len(KzgCommitments) or != len(KzgProofs). SSZ type enforcement ('ssz-size:"?,48"' for KzgCommitments and KzgProofs, 'ssz-size:"?,2048"' for Column) alone doesn't prevent count mismatch. However, VerifyDataColumnSidecar explicitly checks equal counts and rejects before KZG.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No crash path. VerifyDataColumnSidecar returns error (not panic) on length mismatch.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Attacker can send mismatched-count sidecar; VerifyDataColumnSidecar catches it and returns error without panicking.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: No crash vulnerability. Error return path is safe.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: VerifyDataColumnSidecar equal-length check (returns error, not panic)

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Length mismatch is detected and rejected gracefully. Not a crash vulnerability.

title: Supporting Check: Can integer overflow in FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL * cell_index bypass bounds checking or cause unexpected array access?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: In Prysm's Go code, cell_index is sidecar.Index (uint64, max 127 after validation). FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL = 64. Max product = 127 * 64 = 8128, well within uint64 range (no overflow). Any FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL * cell_index computation in ckzg4844 uses C uint64 which also cannot overflow at these values.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: No overflow. Values bounded by pre-validation to max 127.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: No integer overflow possible. Cell index capped at 127 before arithmetic.

title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-002: Are commitment_bytes, cell, and proof_bytes lengths validated to exact constants before processing in verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: SSZ type enforcement: DataColumnSidecar proto has 'ssz-size:"?,48"' for KzgCommitments (commitment_bytes = 48) and KzgProofs (proof_bytes = 48), 'ssz-size:"?,2048"' for Column (cell_bytes = 2048). fastssz deserialization rejects any non-conforming message before validation logic runs. VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs copies to [48]byte commitment/proof arrays (compile-time fixed size).

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No bypass. SSZ enforces exact sizes at deserialization. Copy to [48]byte and [2048]byte fixed arrays is safe.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Byte length validation enforced by SSZ before any Go code processes the data.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Invariant holds: commitment=48 bytes, proof=48 bytes, cell=2048 bytes enforced by SSZ.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: SSZ deserialization (ssz-size tags) + fixed-array copy in VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Exact byte lengths enforced by SSZ schema. No vulnerability.
